Seat note (⛔ not a claim), 2026-11-12T09:01Z: `domain:spec#2` is ready to take this card (contract surface, next in the lane's order), but item 1 needs the request / response / error shapes of `/api/v1/ai/saved-questions`, `…/turns/:turnId/artifact` and `…/turns/:turnId/feedback` as cloud#4107 produces them, and this seat cannot read `objectstack-ai/cloud` (`add_repo` refused: no access). A dev handed no producer reading would guess the shapes, which is the failure this card exists to stop.
Waits-on: a `repo:cloud` seat posting the three shapes on this card (a code reading from cloud#4107: file:line of each handler's input parse and response body, and the error codes it answers). Item 2 (`turn_id` on `AIConversation.messages`) is spec-only and rides the same PR once the shapes are here. The card stays `pm:queue`; this seat claims it the round the reading lands.
